name: prompt-enhancer
description: Rewrites a coding-agent prompt into a repo-grounded spec. omp extension (alt+e, /enhance; no new tests or smoke runs: alt+shift+n, /enhance-notest; fast: alt+shift+e, /enhance-fast; best-in-class feature set: alt+shift+m, /enhance-max), Claude Code plugin, Antigravity CLI plugin (::e or /enhance; ::en or /enhance-notest; ::ef or /enhance-fast; ::em or /enhance-max) and Antigravity IDE extension.
